podcast.title: Complex and Controversial Work
podcast.body: Released around 2008 or 2009, this album is regarded as one of Frusciante's most complete and complex creations. It became controversial, garnering mixed critical reception, with some hailing it as a masterpiece and others dismissing it as pretentious. The Empyrean is notable for its ambitious fusion of classic guitar rock, metal, progressive music, New Wave, synthesizers, and electronic bases, making it a challenging but interesting listen. "Es un disco un tanto polémico porque las críticas son muy mistas, hay quien lo considera una obra maestra, hay quien lo considera una pretentiosidad."

srcs.episode: La historia de John Frusciante: Talento, creatividad y guitarras.

podcast.body: A 2009 record that was noted for being much more coherent compared to his earlier "smacked out solo records" from his addiction period. "If you remember what some of those smacked out solo records sounded like, this one was much, much more coherent."
